problem: A reviewer asked where the component evaluations on real datasets are. The repository had them, but experiments/ held about 45 folders on one level. Indexes linked to files that did not exist, the README limits still said there was no external baseline, and make check failed on main. The failure came from a stale provenance header in contract_coverage.csv after contracts.py gained flagged remedies. Four tests failed on any checkout other than the installed ~/aries.
change: Grouped experiments/ into thesis/, iis/ and archive/, moving 18 non-frozen folders and removing the old symlinks. References in code and docs were rewritten. Every frozen measurement and every historical record was left untouched. Moved scripts that compute the repository root got parents[k+1]. Added docs/DATASETS.md, eval/README.md, experiments/README.md and a preregistration README, and rewrote the three group indexes. scripts/check_links.py is available as make links. eval.sh gained entries for R1, R1b/X1, M2, HAL1, LoCoMo and MIND. CI runs the tables, the figures and the links. The four tests now run on any checkout: the real installation root replaces ~/aries, the frozen compiler is read from its tag, and installer products are skipped.
validation: In a clean clone with a fresh venv from requirements.lock: 17/17 tables, 9/9 figures and 0 broken links. In the working tree: the four previously failing tests pass (27, 14 and 174 checks; the session test is skipped). The thesis build covers 417 ratios with 0 uncovered and passes 82/82 evidence checks.
limitations: The frozen measurements stay at the top of experiments/ because other frozen files and the thesis read them by path. revert-plan.json and the raw inventories still name old paths as historical records. The frozen source archive is not published: its aries/ part equals the tag, but its vendor/ part does not, so the frozen F arm can be rerun only on the author's machine. ruff --select F,E9 reports 42 findings, mostly imports that may register models on import; they were left for a careful pass and lint is not in CI. Lesson: before claiming a layout is clean, run a link checker and the read-only checks in a fresh clone, not in the author's checkout.
